description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for promotions-related endpoints in a Spring Boot application. It provides an API for applying coupon codes, handling input validation, and delegating the business logic to the ApplyCouponFlow service.

classes.name: PromotionsController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for applying coupons in the promotions service. It offers a single POST endpoint to validate and apply coupon codes.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Handles POST requests to apply a coupon code using input validation, and delegates to the business logic component.
